sections.kicker: Prepared for Jason Japan by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Jason Japan speaks like a best friend. The bio speaks like a travel guide.
sections.keep: The cream tiles with serif italic overlays. They read as one hand and a Japan of its own.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things

pins.quote: Its like having a Japan obsessed best friend in the palm of your hand
pins.what: One caption names what the app is: a Japan obsessed best friend.
pins.why: That answers why this guide and not the big travel sites, and it appears once.
pins.how: Put it in the bio and in the first image of the grid.
pins.label: Your caption
pins.cost: The bio calls it a Curated Japan Guide APP, which is what every guide app says.

pins.quote: Hidden gems, best recommendations, tips & all you need to know
pins.what: The bio lists what every travel guide lists.
pins.why: The ownable part is one person's taste, and the bio gives it no face.
pins.how: Lead with who is guiding and what he refuses to include.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Travelers choose between guides on price and star rating.

pins.what: The account is Jason Japan, and the voice switches between Jason and mrjasongrant.
pins.why: Readers cannot tell whose taste they are buying, a brand or a person.
pins.how: Decide whether the guide is a person or a name, and say it the same way everywhere.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: An unclear owner makes the guide look like a fan account.
